sn47.3:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2.
sn47.3:1.2: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā || pe || ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 3.
sn47.3:1.3: Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu || yam aham Bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyaṃ ti
sn47.3:1.4: evam eva panidhekacce moghapurisā mañceva ajjhesanti dhamme ca bhāsite mam eva anubandhitabbam maññantī ti || ||
sn47.3:1.5: Desetu me bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu Sugato saṅkhittena dhammam || appeva nāmāham Bhagavato bhāsitassa atthaṃ jāneyyam appeva nāmāham Bhagavato bhāsitassa dāyādo assan ti || ||
sn47.3:1.6: Tasmātiha tvam bhikkhu ādim eva visodehi kusalesu dhammesu ||
sn47.3:1.8: sīlam ca suvisuddhaṃ diṭṭhi ca ujukā ||
sn47.3:1.9: yato kho te bhikkhu sīlañ ca suvisuddham bhavissati diṭṭhi ca ujukā || tato tvam bhikkhu sīlam nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya cattāro satipaṭṭhāne tividhena bhāveyyāsi ||
sn47.3:2.2: Idha tvam bhikkhu ajjhattaṃ vā kāye kāyānupassī viharāhi || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ||
sn47.3:2.3: bahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharāhi || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || ||
sn47.3:2.4: ajjhattabahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharāhi || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjadomanassaṃ || ||
sn47.3:2.13: ajjhattabahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāhi || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjādomanassaṃ || || 5.
sn47.3:2.14: Yato kho tvam bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne evaṃ tividhena bhāvessasi || tato tuyham bhikkhu yā ratti vā divaso vā āgamissati vuddhi yeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no parihānīti || || 6.
sn47.3:3.1: Atha kho so bhikkhu Bhagavato bhāsitam abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyasanā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi || || 7.
sn47.3:3.2: Atha kho so bhikkhu eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammad eva agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajanti tad anuttaram brahmacariyapariyosānam diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sachikatvā upasampajja vihāsi || ||
sn47.3:3.3: Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyam nāparam itthattāyāti abhiññāsi || || 8.
sn47.3:3.4: Aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahatam ahosīti || || 1.
